raw: Act 3, Scene 4 — A Room in Capulet’s House

sentences.en: A Room in Capulet’s House
sentences.ko: 캐퓰릿 집의 방

summary.en: Capulet decides that Juliet will marry Paris in three days.
summary.ko: 캐퓰릿은 줄리엣을 사흘 뒤 패리스와 결혼시키기로 한다.

raw: Enter Capulet, Lady Capulet and Paris.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Things have fallen out, sir, so unluckily
That we have had no time to move our daughter.
Look you, she lov’d her kinsman Tybalt dearly,
And so did I. Well, we were born to die.
’Tis very late; she’ll not come down tonight.
I promise you, but for your company,
I would have been abed an hour ago.

sentences.en: Things have happened so badly, sir, that we have had no time to persuade our daughter.
sentences.ko: 상황이 너무 안 좋게 돌아가서, 우리 딸을 설득할 겨를이 없었어요.

sentences.en: Look, she loved her cousin Tybalt dearly, and so did I.
sentences.ko: 보시다시피 그 애는 사촌 티볼트를 무척 아꼈고, 나도 그랬어요.

sentences.en: Well, we were born to die.
sentences.ko: 뭐, 우리는 죽기 위해 태어난 존재니까요.

sentences.en: It is very late, so she will not come down tonight.
sentences.ko: 이미 늦은 시간이라 오늘 밤에는 내려오지 않을 거예요.

sentences.en: I promise you that if you were not here, I would have been in bed an hour ago.
sentences.ko: 정말이지, 백작이 계시지 않았다면 나는 한 시간 전에 잠자리에 들었을 거예요.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
These times of woe afford no tune to woo.
Madam, good night. Commend me to your daughter.

sentences.en: These sad times are not good for courting.
sentences.ko: 이런 슬픈 시기에는 구애하기가 좋지 않네요.

sentences.en: Good night, Madam.
sentences.ko: 안녕히 주무십시오, 부인.

sentences.en: Give my regards to your daughter.
sentences.ko: 따님께도 안부 전해 주세요.

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw:
I will, and know her mind early tomorrow;
Tonight she’s mew’d up to her heaviness.

sentences.en: I will do that and find out her thoughts early tomorrow.
sentences.ko: 그러지요. 내일 아침 일찍 그 애의 마음을 알아볼게요.

sentences.en: Tonight she is locked away in her sadness.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 그 애는 슬픔에 갇혀 있답니다.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Sir Paris, I will make a desperate tender
Of my child’s love. I think she will be rul’d
In all respects by me; nay more, I doubt it not.
Wife, go you to her ere you go to bed,
Acquaint her here of my son Paris’ love,
And bid her, mark you me, on Wednesday next,
But, soft, what day is this?

sentences.en: Sir Paris, I will make a bold promise of my child's love.
sentences.ko: 패리스 백작, 내 딸의 사랑은 내가 과감히 약속하리다.

sentences.en: I think she will be ruled by me in all respects.
sentences.ko: 그 애는 모든 일에 내 뜻을 따를 거요.

sentences.en: No, more than that, I am sure of it.
sentences.ko: 아니, 틀림없소.

sentences.en: Wife, go to her before you go to bed.
sentences.ko: 부인, 자기 전에 그 애한테 가 보시오.

sentences.en: Tell her about my son Paris's love.
sentences.ko: 내 아들 같은 패리스의 사랑을 그 애에게 알려 주시오.

sentences.en: And tell her, listen, that next Wednesday—
sentences.ko: 그리고 잘 들으라고 하시오. 다음 수요일에—

sentences.en: But, wait, what day is this?
sentences.ko: 가만, 오늘이 무슨 요일이지?

sentences.en: Monday, my lord.
sentences.ko: 월요일입니다, 어르신.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Monday! Ha, ha! Well, Wednesday is too soon,
A Thursday let it be; a Thursday, tell her,
She shall be married to this noble earl.
Will you be ready? Do you like this haste?
We’ll keep no great ado,—a friend or two,
For, hark you, Tybalt being slain so late,
It may be thought we held him carelessly,
Being our kinsman, if we revel much.
Therefore we’ll have some half a dozen friends,
And there an end. But what say you to Thursday?

sentences.en: Monday! Ha, ha!
sentences.ko: 월요일이라! 하하!

sentences.en: Well, Wednesday is too soon, so let it be Thursday.
sentences.ko: 음, 수요일은 너무 빠르니 목요일로 해요.

sentences.en: Tell her that on Thursday she will marry this noble earl.
sentences.ko: 목요일에 이 고귀한 백작과 결혼한다고 그 애에게 말하시오.

sentences.en: Will you be ready? Do you like this haste?
sentences.ko: 준비되시겠어요? 이렇게 서두르는 게 괜찮으세요?

sentences.en: We will not have a big celebration, just one or two friends.
sentences.ko: 큰 잔치는 열지 않고, 한두 명의 친구만 부를 거예요.

sentences.en: Tybalt was killed so recently.
sentences.ko: 티볼트가 죽은 지 얼마 되지 않았으니까요.

sentences.en: If we celebrate too much, people might think we did not care about our own relative.
sentences.ko: 너무 크게 축하하면 사람들이 우리 친척을 아끼지 않는다고 생각할지도 몰라요.

sentences.en: Therefore, we will have about six friends, and that is the end of it.
sentences.ko: 그러니 친구 대여섯만 부르고 그걸로 끝내겠어요.

sentences.en: But what do you say to Thursday?
sentences.ko: 하지만 목요일은 어떠신가요?

speaker: PARIS
raw: My lord, I would that Thursday were tomorrow.

sentences.en: My lord, I wish that Thursday were tomorrow.
sentences.ko: 어르신, 목요일이 내일이면 좋겠어요.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Well, get you gone. A Thursday be it then.
Go you to Juliet ere you go to bed,
Prepare her, wife, against this wedding day.
Farewell, my lord.—Light to my chamber, ho!
Afore me, it is so very very late that we
May call it early by and by. Good night.

sentences.en: Well, go now.
sentences.ko: 자, 그럼 가 보세요.

sentences.en: Let it be a Thursday then.
sentences.ko: 그럼 목요일로 하죠.

sentences.en: Go to Juliet before you go to bed.
sentences.ko: 부인, 자기 전에 줄리엣에게 가서

sentences.en: Prepare her, wife, for this wedding day.
sentences.ko: 결혼식 준비를 시키시오.

sentences.en: Goodbye, my lord.
sentences.ko: 안녕히 가시오, 백작.

sentences.en: Bring a light to my chamber!
sentences.ko: 내 방에 불을 가져와라!

sentences.en: My goodness, it is so late that soon we can call it early.
sentences.ko: 원, 이렇게 늦었으니 곧 이르다고 해야겠군.

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.ko: 잘 자요.
